paragraphs.text: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led in the Spirit in the wilderness
paragraphs.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου ὑπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ ἤγετο ἐν τῷ πνεύματι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
paragraphs.translit: Iēsous de plērēs pneumatos hagiou hypestrepsen apo tou Iordanou, kai ēgeto en tō pneumati en tē erēmō

paragraphs.text: during forty days, being tempted of the devil. And he did eat nothing in those days: and when they were completed, he hungered.
paragraphs.original: ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου. καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις, καὶ συντελεσθεισῶν αὐτῶν ἐπείνασεν.
paragraphs.translit: hēmeras tesserakonta peirazomenos hypo tou diabolou. kai ouk ephagen ouden en tais hēmerais ekeinais, kai syntelestheisōn autōn epeinasen.

paragraphs.text: And the devil said unto him, if thou art the Son of God, command this stone that it become bread.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος· Εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰπὲ τῷ λίθῳ τούτῳ ἵνα γένηται ἄρτος.
paragraphs.translit: eipen de autō ho diabolos· Ei hyios ei tou theou, eipe tō lithō toutō hina genētai artos.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus answered unto him, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἐπʼ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος.
paragraphs.translit: kai apekrithē pros auton ho Iēsous· Gegraptai hoti Ouk epʼ artō monō zēsetai ho anthrōpos.

paragraphs.text: And he led him up, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἀναγαγὼν αὐτὸν ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν στιγμῇ χρόνου·
paragraphs.translit: Kai anagagōn auton edeixen autō pasas tas basileias tēs oikoumenēs en stigmē chronou·

paragraphs.text: And the devil said unto him, To thee will I give all this authority, and the glory of them: for it hath been delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος· Σοὶ δώσω τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἅπασαν καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐμοὶ παραδέδοται καὶ ᾧ ἂν θέλω δίδωμι αὐτήν·
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen autō ho diabolos· Soi dōsō tēn exousian tautēn hapasan kai tēn doxan autōn, hoti emoi paradedotai kai hō an thelō didōmi autēn·

paragraphs.text: If thou therefore wilt worship before me, it shall all be thine.
paragraphs.original: σὺ οὖν ἐὰν προσκυνήσῃς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ, ἔσται σοῦ πᾶσα.
paragraphs.translit: sy oun ean proskynēsēs enōpion emou, estai sou pasa.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, It is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Γέγραπται· Κύριον τὸν θεόν σου προσκυνήσεις καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις.
paragraphs.translit: kai apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen autō· Gegraptai· Kyrion ton theon sou proskynēseis kai autō monō latreuseis.

paragraphs.text: And he led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
paragraphs.original: Ἤγαγεν δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, βάλε σεαυτὸν ἐντεῦθεν κάτω·
paragraphs.translit: Ēgagen de auton eis Ierousalēm kai estēsen epi to pterygion tou hierou, kai eipen autō· Ei hyios ei tou theou, bale seauton enteuthen katō·

paragraphs.text: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to guard thee:
paragraphs.original: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε,
paragraphs.translit: gegraptai gar hoti Tois angelois autou enteleitai peri sou tou diaphylaxai se,

paragraphs.text: and, On their hands they shall bear thee up, Lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὅτι Ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε μήποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.
paragraphs.translit: kai hoti Epi cheirōn arousin se mēpote proskopsēs pros lithon ton poda sou.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Εἴρηται· Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου.
paragraphs.translit: kai apokritheis eipen autō ho Iēsous hoti Eirētai· Ouk ekpeiraseis kyrion ton theon sou.

paragraphs.text: And when the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him for a season.
paragraphs.original: καὶ συντελέσας πάντα πειρασμὸν ὁ διάβολος ἀπέστη ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἄχρι καιροῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai syntelesas panta peirasmon ho diabolos apestē apʼ autou achri kairou.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and a fame went out concerning him through all the region round about.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ πνεύματος εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν. καὶ φήμη ἐξῆλθεν καθʼ ὅλης τῆς περιχώρου περὶ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hypestrepsen ho Iēsous en tē dynamei tou pneumatos eis tēn Galilaian. kai phēmē exēlthen kathʼ holēs tēs perichōrou peri autou.

paragraphs.text: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδίδασκεν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν, δοξαζόμενος ὑπὸ πάντων.
paragraphs.translit: kai autos edidasken en tais synagōgais autōn, doxazomenos hypo pantōn.

paragraphs.text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and he entered, as his custom was, into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up to read.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρά, οὗ ἦν τεθραμμένος, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν κατὰ τὸ εἰωθὸς αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν, καὶ ἀνέστη ἀναγνῶναι.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ēlthen eis Nazara, hou ēn tethrammenos, kai eisēlthen kata to eiōthos autō en tē hēmera tōn sabbatōn eis tēn synagōgēn, kai anestē anagnōnai.

paragraphs.text: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And he opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπεδόθη αὐτῷ βιβλίον τοῦ προφήτου Ἠσαΐου καὶ ἀναπτύξας τὸ βιβλίον εὗρεν τὸν τόπον οὗ ἦν γεγραμμένον·
paragraphs.translit: kai epedothē autō biblion tou prophētou Ēsaiou kai anaptyxas to biblion heuren ton topon hou ēn gegrammenon·

paragraphs.text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, Because he anointed me to preach good tidings to the poor: He hath sent me to proclaim release to the captives, And recovering of sight to the blind, To set at liberty them that are bruised,
paragraphs.original: Πνεῦμα κυρίου ἐπʼ ἐμέ, οὗ εἵνεκεν ἔχρισέν με εὐαγγελίσασθαι πτωχοῖς, ἀπέσταλκέν με κηρύξαι αἰχμαλώτοις ἄφεσιν καὶ τυφλοῖς ἀνάβλεψιν, ἀποστεῖλαι τεθραυσμένους ἐν ἀφέσει,
paragraphs.translit: Pneuma kyriou epʼ eme, hou heineken echrisen me euangelisasthai ptōchois, apestalken me kēryxai aichmalōtois aphesin kai typhlois anablepsin, aposteilai tethrausmenous en aphesei,

paragraphs.text: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.
paragraphs.original: κηρύξαι ἐνιαυτὸν κυρίου δεκτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kēryxai eniauton kyriou dekton.

paragraphs.text: And he closed the book, and gave it back to the attendant, and sat down: and the eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πτύξας τὸ βιβλίον ἀποδοὺς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ ἐκάθισεν· καὶ πάντων οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦσαν ἀτενίζοντες αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ptyxas to biblion apodous tō hypēretē ekathisen· kai pantōn hoi ophthalmoi en tē synagōgē ēsan atenizontes autō.

paragraphs.text: And he began to say unto them, To-day hath this scripture been fulfilled in your ears.
paragraphs.original: ἤρξατο δὲ λέγειν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Σήμερον πεπλήρωται ἡ γραφὴ αὕτη ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ērxato de legein pros autous hoti Sēmeron peplērōtai hē graphē hautē en tois ōsin hymōn.

paragraphs.text: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the words of grace which proceeded out of his mouth: and they said, Is not this Joseph`s son?
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες ἐμαρτύρουν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις τῆς χάριτος τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλεγον· Οὐχὶ υἱός ἐστιν Ἰωσὴφ οὗτος;
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes emartyroun autō kai ethaumazon epi tois logois tēs charitos tois ekporeuomenois ek tou stomatos autou, kai elegon· Ouchi hyios estin Iōsēph houtos;

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, Doubtless ye will say unto me this parable, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in thine own country.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Πάντως ἐρεῖτέ μοι τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην· Ἰατρέ, θεράπευσον σεαυτόν· ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν γενόμενα εἰς τὴν Καφαρναοὺμ ποίησον καὶ ὧδε ἐν τῇ πατρίδι σου.
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen pros autous· Pantōs ereite moi tēn parabolēn tautēn· Iatre, therapeuson seauton· hosa ēkousamen genomena eis tēn Kapharnaoum poiēson kai hōde en tē patridi sou.

paragraphs.text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is acceptable in his own country.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν δέ· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς προφήτης δεκτός ἐστιν ἐν τῇ πατρίδι αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: eipen de· Amēn legō hymin hoti oudeis prophētēs dektos estin en tē patridi autou.

paragraphs.text: But of a truth I say unto you, There were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when there came a great famine over all the land;
paragraphs.original: ἐπʼ ἀληθείας δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, πολλαὶ χῆραι ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἠλίου ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ, ὅτε ἐκλείσθη ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπὶ ἔτη τρία καὶ μῆνας ἕξ, ὡς ἐγένετο λιμὸς μέγας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν,
paragraphs.translit: epʼ alētheias de legō hymin, pollai chērai ēsan en tais hēmerais Ēliou en tō Israēl, hote ekleisthē ho ouranos epi etē tria kai mēnas hex, hōs egeneto limos megas epi pasan tēn gēn,

paragraphs.text: and unto none of them was Elijah sent, but only to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πρὸς οὐδεμίαν αὐτῶν ἐπέμφθη Ἠλίας εἰ μὴ εἰς Σάρεπτα τῆς Σιδωνίας πρὸς γυναῖκα χήραν.
paragraphs.translit: kai pros oudemian autōn epemphthē Ēlias ei mē eis Sarepta tēs Sidōnias pros gynaika chēran.

paragraphs.text: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, but only Naaman the Syrian.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πολλοὶ λεπροὶ ἦσαν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου τοῦ προφήτου, καὶ οὐδεὶς αὐτῶν ἐκαθαρίσθη, εἰ μὴ Ναιμὰν ὁ Σύρος.
paragraphs.translit: kai polloi leproi ēsan en tō Israēl epi Elisaiou tou prophētou, kai oudeis autōn ekatharisthē, ei mē Naiman ho Syros.

paragraphs.text: And they were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες θυμοῦ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἀκούοντες ταῦτα,
paragraphs.translit: kai eplēsthēsan pantes thymou en tē synagōgē akouontes tauta,

paragraphs.text: and they rose up, and cast him forth out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might throw him down headlong.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀναστάντες ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἕως ὀφρύος τοῦ ὄρους ἐφʼ οὗ ἡ πόλις ᾠκοδόμητο αὐτῶν, ὥστε κατακρημνίσαι αὐτόν·
paragraphs.translit: kai anastantes exebalon auton exō tēs poleōs, kai ēgagon auton heōs ophryos tou orous ephʼ hou hē polis ōkodomēto autōn, hōste katakrēmnisai auton·

paragraphs.text: But he passing through the midst of them went his way.
paragraphs.original: αὐτὸς δὲ διελθὼν διὰ μέσου αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο.
paragraphs.translit: autos de dielthōn dia mesou autōn eporeueto.

paragraphs.text: And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. And he was teaching them on the sabbath day:
paragraphs.original: Καὶ κατῆλθεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας. καὶ ἦν διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν·
paragraphs.translit: Kai katēlthen eis Kapharnaoum polin tēs Galilaias. kai ēn didaskōn autous en tois sabbasin·

paragraphs.text: and they were astonished at his teaching; for his word was with authority.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ ἦν ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai exeplēssonto epi tē didachē autou, hoti en exousia ēn ho logos autou.

paragraphs.text: And in the synagogue there was a man, that had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἔχων πνεῦμα δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου, καὶ ἀνέκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ·
paragraphs.translit: kai en tē synagōgē ēn anthrōpos echōn pneuma daimoniou akathartou, kai anekraxen phōnē megalē·

paragraphs.text: Ah! what have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
paragraphs.original: Ἔα, τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ; ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς; οἶδά σε τίς εἶ, ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Ea, ti hēmin kai soi, Iēsou Nazarēne; ēlthes apolesai hēmas; oida se tis ei, ho hagios tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the demon had thrown him down in the midst, he came out of him, having done him no hurt.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ. καὶ ῥίψαν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον εἰς τὸ μέσον ἐξῆλθεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ μηδὲν βλάψαν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai epetimēsen autō ho Iēsous legōn· Phimōthēti kai exelthe apʼ autou. kai rhipsan auton to daimonion eis to meson exēlthen apʼ autou mēden blapsan auton.

paragraphs.text: And amazement came upon all, and they spake together, one with another, saying, What is this word? for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐγένετο θάμβος ἐπὶ πάντας, καὶ συνελάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες· Τίς ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ καὶ δυνάμει ἐπιτάσσει τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις πνεύμασιν, καὶ ἐξέρχονται;
paragraphs.translit: kai egeneto thambos epi pantas, kai synelaloun pros allēlous legontes· Tis ho logos houtos hoti en exousia kai dynamei epitassei tois akathartois pneumasin, kai exerchontai;

paragraphs.text: And there went forth a rumor concerning him into every place of the region round about.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο ἦχος περὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς πάντα τόπον τῆς περιχώρου.
paragraphs.translit: kai exeporeueto ēchos peri autou eis panta topon tēs perichōrou.

paragraphs.text: And he rose up from the synagogue, and entered into the house of Simon. And Simon`s wife`s mother was holden with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
paragraphs.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος. πενθερὰ δὲ τοῦ Σίμωνος ἦν συνεχομένη πυρετῷ μεγάλῳ, καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν περὶ αὐτῆς.
paragraphs.translit: Anastas de apo tēs synagōgēs eisēlthen eis tēn oikian Simōnos. penthera de tou Simōnos ēn synechomenē pyretō megalō, kai ērōtēsan auton peri autēs.

paragraphs.text: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she rose up and ministered unto them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπιστὰς ἐπάνω αὐτῆς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ πυρετῷ, καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτήν· παραχρῆμα δὲ ἀναστᾶσα διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai epistas epanō autēs epetimēsen tō pyretō, kai aphēken autēn· parachrēma de anastasa diēkonei autois.

paragraphs.text: And when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
paragraphs.original: Δύνοντος δὲ τοῦ ἡλίου ἅπαντες ὅσοι εἶχον ἀσθενοῦντας νόσοις ποικίλαις ἤγαγον αὐτοὺς πρὸς αὐτόν· ὁ δὲ ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιτιθεὶς ἐθεράπευεν αὐτούς.
paragraphs.translit: Dynontos de tou hēliou hapantes hosoi eichon asthenountas nosois poikilais ēgagon autous pros auton· ho de heni hekastō autōn tas cheiras epititheis etherapeuen autous.

paragraphs.text: And demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, Thou art the Son of God. And rebuking them, he suffered them not to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
paragraphs.original: ἐξήρχετο δὲ καὶ δαιμόνια ἀπὸ πολλῶν κραυγάζοντα καὶ λέγοντα ὅτι Σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ. καὶ ἐπιτιμῶν οὐκ εἴα αὐτὰ λαλεῖν, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν τὸν χριστὸν αὐτὸν εἶναι.
paragraphs.translit: exērcheto de kai daimonia apo pollōn kraugazonta kai legonta hoti Sy ei ho hyios tou theou. kai epitimōn ouk eia auta lalein, hoti ēdeisan ton christon auton einai.

paragraphs.text: And when it was day, he came out and went into a desert place: and the multitudes sought after him, and came unto him, and would have stayed him, that he should not go from them.
paragraphs.original: Γενομένης δὲ ἡμέρας ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη εἰς ἔρημον τόπον· καὶ οἱ ὄχλοι ἐπεζήτουν αὐτόν, καὶ ἦλθον ἕως αὐτοῦ, καὶ κατεῖχον αὐτὸν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι ἀπʼ αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Genomenēs de hēmeras exelthōn eporeuthē eis erēmon topon· kai hoi ochloi epezētoun auton, kai ēlthon heōs autou, kai kateichon auton tou mē poreuesthai apʼ autōn.

paragraphs.text: But he said unto them, I must preach the good tidings of the kingdom of God to the other cities also: for therefore was I sent.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Καὶ ταῖς ἑτέραις πόλεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαί με δεῖ τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅτι ἐπὶ τοῦτο ἀπεστάλην.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen pros autous hoti Kai tais heterais polesin euangelisasthai me dei tēn basileian tou theou, hoti epi touto apestalēn.

paragraphs.text: And he was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς τῆς Ἰουδαίας.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēn kēryssōn eis tas synagōgas tēs Ioudaias.
